entries.name: Evoker
entries: Evokers wield the magic of the five ordered dragonflights (detailed in {@book chapter 7|WoW|7})—the chaotic flames of the {@book red flight|WoW|7|Red Dragonflight}, the focused magic of the {@book blue flight|WoW|7|Blue Dragonflight}, the might of the {@book black flight|WoW|7|Black Dragonflight}, the life-giving spirit of the {@book green flight|WoW|7|Green Dragonflight}, and the time-bending magic of the {@book bronze flight|WoW|7|Bronze Dragonflight}. Evokers channel this power to devastate their enemies and bolster their allies, using their heightened mobility to dart in and out of the fray.
Evokers can empower, extend, and transmute their spells to suit their needs. They can also charge up their spellcasting, entering a state of heightened magical power.
